root_cause: RuPay debit transactions are incurring commercial card fee downgrades due to missing Level 2/3 data inputs.
diagnosis: The merchant was undercharged or miscalculated against an illustrative benchmark benchmark fee model due to L2/L3 commercial downgrade rules across 3 RuPay debit transactions, resulting in a modeled variance of Rs -1,552.38.
action_rationale: Providing Level 2 and Level 3 transaction data prevents commercial card downgrades and ensures accurate processing fee application.
